title: Modeling Document and Section Hierarchies in Embedding Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.21980v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embedded topic models integrate word embeddings into the topic generation process, producing coherent topics and robust performance on large vocabularies. However, each document is represented by a single topic distribution, ignoring its internal structure. Many real world collections, including legal documents, company and government reports, and online discussion forums, exhibit hierarchical organization in which documents consist of multiple sections that often address distinct subtopics. We introduce the Hierarchical Embedded Topic Model (hETM), a structured topic model that couples the topic distribution of a document and those of its sections through a hierarchical prior in the embedding space. We derive an amortized variational inference procedure for hETM and evaluate it on structured collections from each of these domains. translated_title: 在嵌入空间中对文档与章节层次结构建模
translated_abstract: 嵌入式主题模型将词嵌入整合到主题生成过程中，能够产生连贯的主题，并在大词表上表现出稳健的性能。然而，每篇文档仅由单个主题分布表示，忽略了其内部结构。许多现实世界的语料库，包括法律文档、公司和政府报告以及在线讨论论坛，都呈现出层次化的组织结构：文档由多个章节组成，而这些章节往往涉及不同的子主题。我们提出了层次化嵌入式主题模型，这是一种结构化主题模型，通过嵌入空间中的层次先验将文档的主题分布与其各章节的主题分布相耦合。我们为 hETM 推导了一种摊销变分推断过程，并在来自上述各领域的结构化语料库上对其进行评估。实验结果表明，hETM 在扁平模型与……之中取得了最低或接近最低的留出集困惑度（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出层次化嵌入式主题模型，通过嵌入空间中的层次先验将文档级与章节级主题分布相耦合，并借助摊销变分推断在法律、报告和论坛等多个领域的结构化语料库上取得了最低或接近最低的困惑度表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Hierarchical Embedded Topic Model (hETM), which couples document-level and section-level topic distributions through a hierarchical prior in embedding space and, via amortized variational inference, achieves the lowest or near-lowest held-out perplexity on structured collections across multiple domains.
